title: docs(adr): ADR-0011's identity-action census says one identity action is unassessed; sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options (#30967) makes it two
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

## What is wrong

`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` (identity-actions note, "Not assessed") says `sys_user.list_platform_admins` is "the one identity action that postdates the assessment and is in no bucket above", and the census line above it counts "one more identity action, unassessed".

PR #31448 (#30967, items 1/2/4) adds a second identity action after the assessment: `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options` (Setup → SSO Providers → Edit Sign-In Options), declared with no `ai` block, so human-only. Once it merges, the ADR's count and its "the one" sentence are false.

## Expected

The "Not assessed" paragraph and the census line name both unassessed identity actions (human-only, no `ai` block, until a maintainer ruling assesses them), or a maintainer ruling assesses the new action into a bucket. No code change.

## Where to start

- `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`, the identity-actions note (~:365-382 on `main` at the time of filing).
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts`, action `edit_sso_sign_in_options` (lands with PR #31448).

## Provenance

Contract review 6719336371 on PR #31448, ③ boundary flag (the dev report's "ADR-0011 not edited, the new action is human-only" leaves the ADR's count stale). Filed by the seat as its carrier. `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface (Tier H); this card waits for PR #31448 to merge.
